incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC-3951 — Zenbrook VPC app-gateway streaming: websocket disconnects and 502 spikes. Impacting live customer sessions. Paging oncall Anne.
Anne (oncall): On it. Joining call now, will gather quick impact. Can someone drop recent error rates? :phone:
Miguel (eng-sre): Seeing spike in 101/102 websocket closes and a surge of 502s from our app-proxy to Zenbrook's upstream between 12:34-12:42 UTC. Metrics: ws_conn_errors +32%, 502_rate +18%.
Priya (eng-runtime): Logs show repeated EOF on the keepalive stream and rapid retry bursts from the customer's gateway. Likely their gateway is retrying aggressively and tripping our connection pool. Sample log:
```
2026-02-17T12:36:11Z proxy[gw-03]: ws: read EOF from upstream, conn_id=abc123
2026-02-17T12:36:11Z proxy[gw-03]: 502 response from backend, code=502, backend=dedicated-pool-zenbrook
```
Lina (support): Ben (Zenbrook) joined the channel on PM, they're seeing user-facing disconnects and some UI retries. They've paused non-essential background syncs.
Ben - Zenbrook (ops): Confirmed. ~28% of streaming sessions dropped for a 6-8 minute window, users getting reconnect loop. We're getting a lot of retries from the browser-side SDK.
Jay (AE): I'm on with Ben. Their SRE says their gateway has an aggressive 3s retry policy on WS failures — could be amplifying. They can roll to a 10s backoff if we recommend.
Anne (oncall): Priority plan: 1) Mitigate customer impact (temporary server-side throttling + enable long-poll fallback), 2) Reduce retry amplification, 3) Investigate pool/backpressure and implement long-term fixes. Who can toggle fallback for Zenbrook?
Priya (eng-runtime): I can enable HTTP long-poll fallback for Zenbrook's tenant on the VPC gateway (config toggle). That will route clients to SSE/long-poll if WS fails — low-risk. Applying now.
Miguel (eng-sre): I'll put a soft rate limit on the Zenbrook tenant at the proxy layer to limit retry storming: token bucket 200r/s burst 400r. Pushing rule in 30s.
Raj (infra-ml): Observed KV-cache thrash on the dedicated pool for Zenbrook during the spike. Add ephemeral KV connection cap to reduce backend overload while we stabilize.
Ben - Zenbrook (ops): We'll change retry policy from 3s -> 12s on the customer gateway. Rolling config now, ETA ~3m.
incident-bot: Action noted: fallback enabled (feature-flag: zenbrook-fallback=true) by Priya; rate-limit rule applied by Miguel; customer retry backoff in progress.
Priya (eng-runtime): Fallback enabled. Confirming clients are seeing SSE reconnects instead of immediate WS failures. Telemetry shows SSE success for new sessions.
Miguel (eng-sre): Rate limit in place. 502 and ws_conn_errors dropping in the last 60s. Metrics: ws_conn_errors down -58% from peak, 502s down -40%.
Lina (support): Ben reports immediate reduction in user complaints. Thanks team. I'll update Zenbrook incident channel with current mitigations and ask them to monitor.
Jay (AE): Notifying account exec chain and legal (brief FYI). We should offer postmortem once stable.
Anne (oncall): Handing off to Miguel for investigation and follow-up. Miguel, please own the on-call investigation and coordinate postmortem with Ben and AE.
Miguel (eng-sre): On it. Initial hypothesis: retry amplification from customer's gateway + insufficient upstream connection backpressure. Next steps: gather connection dump, proxy thread traces, and review pooling config for Zenbrook's dedicated pool.
Ben - Zenbrook (ops): Appreciate the quick mitigation. We'll keep retry backoff and watch for any regressions.
Raj (infra-ml): I'll run a quick smoke to validate KV caps didn't cause side effects. Report back in 10.
Anne (oncall): Thanks. I'll close the active page but keep this channel open for updates. Oncall shift ends in ~35m; Miguel you'll become primary oncall lead.
Miguel (eng-sre): Acknowledged — I'll coordinate post-incident timeline and owners. Assigning postmortem owner: Miguel. Suggested Sev: P1->P2 after mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> customer impact reduced. Incident will remain open for investigation. Pager cleared for Anne. :white_check_mark:
Lina (support): I'll collect user session ids for Zenbrook and hand them to Miguel for trace correlation.
Ben - Zenbrook (ops): We'll provide gateway logs and current retry config. Thanks everyone.
Priya (eng-runtime): Note for postmortem: consider adding tenant-specific adaptive backoff controls and a runtime knob to auto-enable fallback when ws failure rate > X.
Miguel (eng-sre): Noted. I'll include remediation suggestions in the postmortem draft. Target ETA for postmortem: 72h.
Anne (oncall): Great work. If anything spikes again, re-page immediately. Closing conversational handoff here.
